accept: abs(p_cpu-p_reference)<=5pp and no unsuccessful reference/warmup offers or warmup throttle; no tuning
assumptions: aggregate cgroup CPU includes service/control overhead; not perrequest CPU and not cycles or physical frequency; additive mapping assumes serial onCPU contribution and stable nonCPU time and warmup-to-measurement persistence
calibration_cpu_reference: sum isolated warmup CPU use / sum warmup offers for the two corresponding reference calibration cohorts; compare warmup with warmup
candidate: absolute CDF miss-probability change at D under additive CPU-duration shift
comparators: ordinary CPU-conditioned additive CDF identical to candidate correction
counter: cgroup cpu.stat usage_usec delta around completed25-offer warmup
decision_time: after25 warmup offers and counter snapshots, before future measurement
evaluation: all-offer reference-error >5pp warnings and coverage, separate10%-90% transition and policy subgroups; futureCPU used only for persistence assessment
limits: originalNGINX lacks isolated baseline; no originalexcursion score, no independent validation, no new traffic
reference: policy-matched power pool; ordinary fixed5/s rate pool
role: retrospective development after timing-shift screen and CPU-counter inventory; historical outcomes known
